UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: User workspace configuration, training lock schedule, Chrome vault link token, and global pinned memory anchor.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

trainingLocked.description: Whether the training studio lock is active.

trainingDays.description: Configured number of training lock days.

trainingUnlockAtMillis.description: Epoch millis when the training lock completes.

chromeVaultToken.description: Sync token linking this workspace to Chrome web storage.

pinnedContextAnchor.description: Persistent global core objective and context anchor.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: A persistent AI chat session with rolling long-context memory anchor.

contextSummary.description: Rolling long-context summary to prevent distraction.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message inside a conversation with optional code preview, verified sources, attachments, and Hunger reports.

content.description: Markdown or plain text message body.

codeBlock.description: Optional verified code block for copy and live preview.

codeLanguage.description: Language of the code block (e.g., html, kotlin).

deepSearchUsed.description: Whether deep web verification was used.

emotionTag.description: Detected user emotion tag in live voice mode.

attachmentNames.description: List of attached file or image names.

marketingPromptPending.description: Whether Yes/No marketing client search buttons are active.

marketingProjectContext.description: Project idea context for marketing client search.

TrainingBook.title: TrainingBook
TrainingBook.description: An uploaded book or document queued or processed by the autonomous Training Studio.

qaCount.description: Total Q&A scenarios extracted from this book.

KnowledgeEntry.title: KnowledgeEntry
KnowledgeEntry.description: A permanent expert Q&A and scenario unit stored in the cloud Knowledge Vault.

expertAnswer.description: Deep expert answer derived from book context.

HungerReport.title: HungerReport
HungerReport.description: Autonomous knowledge gap research report generated as a .txt file by The Hunger engine.

reportContent.description: Full text content of the Hunger .txt file.

learnedIntoVault.description: Whether findings were ingested into Knowledge Vault.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user workspace state, training lock settings, and global memory anchor.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{convId}.description: User chat conversations with rolling long-context summaries.

/users/{userId}/conversations/{convId}/m.description: Messages belonging to a user conversation.

/users/{userId}/training_books/{bookId}.description: Books and files uploaded for deep cover-to-cover training.

/users/{userId}/knowledge_vault/{entryId.description: Permanent Knowledge Vault of extracted Q&As, scenarios, and Hunger web knowledge.

/users/{userId}/hunger_reports/{reportId.description: Permanent archive of generated Hunger .txt self-learning files.
